about: The Workbench icons of the GLtron drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's art/default/gltron.png at 48x48. GLtron-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, GLtron.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's GLtron.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence; Folder.info for data, art, scripts, music and the drawers in them.
